Daily Devotional

January 15

6 One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all. (Ephesians 4:6 KJV)

This is such an amazing thing, that God is everywhere, and lives in all the born again believers. We call this the Trinity, as God is one person, yet manifests Himself in at least three forms, Father, Son and Holy Ghost. Us humans can’t really understand this, as the spiritual realm is entirely different from our physical world, and has different capabilities. We have to accept the teachings from God’s Word by faith, as faith is what pleases God (Hebrews 11:6). It obviously takes faith to believe in things that we can not perceive with our five senses.

It is my opinion and it is only an opinion as I don’t know that the Holy Spirit gave me this knowledge or not, that God is comprised of at least seven different Spirits, as the book of Revelations says that the seven Spirits of God were before the Throne. Also we humans were made in the image of God, and we are seven part beings as we have five physical senses (see, hear, smell, feel, taste), and then have our souls and spirit. At any rate, God is so awesome in that He can be complete as the Father, and as the Son, and as the Holy Ghost all at the same time. We will be able to fully understand these spiritual things when we see Jesus again, and become like Him and know all things (1 Corinthians 13:12). With all the end time signs showing up in this day of time, it won’t be long before we do meet our Savior face to face. Thank you Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
